A Microsoft Fabric Livy session

Source: R/fabric_livy_session.R
FabricLivySession.Rd

FabricLivySession represents either a regular interactive Livy session or a high-concurrency (HC) session. Create instances with fabric_livy_session() rather than calling $new() directly. Use $wait() before submitting work, $run() for a convenient submit-and-wait operation, and $close() when finished.

Format

An R6::R6Class generator.

Public fields

id

Fabric session or high-concurrency acquisition ID.

url

Session lifecycle URL.

state

Latest service state.

response

Latest raw service response.

closed

Whether $close() completed.

high_concurrency

Whether this is a high-concurrency session.

session_id

Underlying Livy session ID for HC sessions.

repl_id

Isolated REPL ID for HC sessions.

verbose

Whether lifecycle messages are enabled.
